description: This Java class 'BatchRequestContextHolder' manages thread-local storage for batch request attributes, transaction statuses, and transaction scope flags within the Fineract project.

classes.name: BatchRequestContextHolder
classes.description: A utility class providing thread-local management of batch request attributes and transaction context.

methods.name: isBatchRequest
methods.description: Checks if batch attributes are set for the current thread.

methods.name: getRequestAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves the batch attributes for the current thread.

methods.name: setRequestAttributes
methods.description: Sets the batch attributes for the current thread.

methods.name: resetRequestAttributes
methods.description: Removes the batch attributes for the current thread.

methods.name: isEnclosingTransaction
methods.description: Checks if the current thread is within an enclosing transaction.

methods.name: setIsEnclosingTransaction
methods.description: Sets the flag indicating whether the current thread is within an enclosing transaction.

methods.name: resetIsEnclosingTransaction
methods.description: Removes the enclosing transaction flag for the current thread.

methods.name: getTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves the current transaction status for the thread.

methods.name: getEnclosingTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves the transaction status if within an enclosing transaction; otherwise, returns empty.

methods.name: setTransaction
methods.description: Sets the transaction status for the current thread.

methods.name: setEnclosingTransaction
methods.description: Sets the transaction status if within an enclosing transaction.

methods.name: resetTransaction
methods.description: Clears the transaction status for the current thread.
